Let us define a view branch\_cost as follows:
“create view branch cost as select branch name, customer name from depositor, account where depositor.account number=account.account number"

Suppose that the view is materialized; that is, the view is computed and stored. Write triggers to maintain the view, that is, to keep it up-to-date on insertions to depositor or account. It is not necessary to handle deletions on updates. Note that, for simplicity, the elimination of duplicates is not required.
